blurb: Visit sites where visitors have reported strange occurrences including the historic theater, the oldest church and park, Heritage Square, the old area of the red light district, and many more sites the spirits of the dead still linger at. We will also visit historic sites linked to Phoenix’s history and share the historical stories of the past and tragedies that left the spirits stuck here for eternity. Go at your own pace, anytime. Want to go at 2am? Ok. 1pm? Ok too. This tour is all on our walking tour app. Please check the "How to take the tour" section for details on our app and how to take the tour.
